description: Maya's default BlendShapeChannel DeformPercent values, transcribed from her Unity package config (the weights loaded on pak load). Re-apply with tools/apply_avatar_blendshape_defaults.py if her ASCII source is ever regenerated from the binary Maya.fbx (which ships without these baked in).
provenance: Unity SkinnedMeshRenderer blendshape weights, per-mesh. Source screenshots: temp/Blendshape_for_*.png
notes: FACE morphs are intentionally NOT listed -> all 0. With the lip-sync viseme 'Λ' (U+039B) at 0, Maya's neutral face is a smile.
Match key is (mesh, channel) by name. Bra_X=100 is already baked in the FBX; the rest are Unity-only defaults.
Hat / Cloth entries apply only when those meshes aren't dropped at assemble time.
